thesis: The page is the masking-tape inventory stuck on the basement chest-freezer lid: every section is one dated line in pencil, and scrolling ticks the year off month by month until the last blank line is yours to fill in.

signature.name: Freezer-Lid Tape List
signature.summary: A drawn masking-tape strip with torn ends, ruled lines, a small-caps month margin and a pencil tick that draws as each line enters. Hero: the tape marquee of drawn month entries under the statement; year story: Jan-Dec ribbon where each month is ticked and its drawn vignette frosts or warms; services and sample prices are inventory lines with pencil margin notes; reviews are notes tucked under the tape; the form is the last blank line; footer is the torn-off final entry.

palette.family: Freezer-Lid Wheat + Barn Red + January Dusk

layoutMoves: left small-caps month margin column (2 of 12 cols) runs the whole page like the lid list's date column
photo-free: every image is a drawn single-weight line vignette on tape, hatch-shaded frost blue or wheat by season
pinned Jan-Dec ribbon story with ticks, stacked lines under 640px; entries skewed 0.6deg like tape

motion.intro: h1 lines unmask 70ms stagger, tape marquee slides in from right, first pencil tick draws at 0.9s; skippable, text readable at frame 0
stories: Tick the year: pinned Jan-Dec ribbon, each month's tick draws and its vignette frosts or warms (draw)
Thaw clock: freezer outline frost line drains from 48h or 24h as inputs change (dial)
motion.hover: pencil underline scaleX 0 to 1 from left, 200ms
